result.notes:
These day-ahead power exchange prices are wholesale electricity rates for delivery the following day and are provided here by Nord Pool. These are published in £/MWh and can vary due to supply and demand.

National Energy System Operator Limited (NESO) has prepared this data portal in line with its duty under the EU Transparency Regulation No 543/2013.  This data portal is intended to provide transparency for users by providing day-ahead index prices on a five-year rolling basis. 

While we have made reasonable inquiries to ensure the accuracy of the data, no warranty can be or is made as to the accuracy and completeness of the data.
